title: Lack of assignment inference between unaligned token sets
description: Engine assumes inputs are already perfectly paired via zip(terms, labels). Cannot discover term-label mappings from real unaligned tokens.
recommendation: Implement bounded assignment optimization lattice in M2R-v2.

title: Minimum support >= 3 violated via k=2 search parameter
description: Search loops over k in (2, 3, 4). When k=2 gives higher score than k=3, rules with support 2 are returned, violating the freeze contract.
recommendation: Enforce k >= 3 strictly in search loop in M2R-v2.

title: Fictive support counting from duplicate rows and internal repetitions
description: Counter(pairs) counts character-level co-occurrences without tracking independent instance IDs. Duplicate tokens or repeated characters in one word inflate support.
recommendation: Track unique concept/instance IDs per rule occurrence in M2R-v2.

title: Synthetic validation metric hardcodes target alphabet oker
description: Precision metric prec = sum(r[target] in oker) hardcodes 4 synthetic letters. Completely breaks on any other alphabet or real data.
recommendation: Compute precision against latent rule ground truth dynamically.

title: Dict comprehension silently overwrites conflicting rules
description: d = {(r[source_role], r[source]): r[target] for r in rules} drops earlier targets if multiple conflicting targets exist for the same source.
recommendation: Disallow conflicting rules or penalize inconsistency in model scoring.

title: Missing SHA256 checksum ledger in frozen engine package
description: Package lacks SHA256SUMS file at freeze time, preventing automated cryptographic validation of frozen snapshot integrity.
recommendation: Include complete SHA256SUMS manifest in all frozen packages.

title: Absence of bounded search orchestration and resource limits
description: No beam search, no state limit, no CPU/timeout bounds, no checkpoint/resume, and no status assignment logic exist in the engine.
recommendation: Implement full production orchestration with bounded state search in M2R-v2.

title: Absence of recurrent multi-character unit segmentation
description: units(s) returns tuple(s) and is never called. Engine is strictly a 1:1 character substitution cipher, not a recurrent morphology engine.
recommendation: Implement true morpheme / syllable segmentation and composition.

title: Unnormalized raw scoring introduces massive sample-size bias
description: fit and un are unnormalized sums. Scoring discriminates heavily between circular (29 tokens), star (57 tokens), and intro (68 tokens).
recommendation: Implement description-length normalization per token / block.

title: Silent truncation on unequal string lengths in zip(t, l)
description: zip(t, l) truncates to the shorter string, ignoring extra characters during rule induction and only penalizing them post-hoc in score.
recommendation: Support variable-length alignment and explicit gap modeling.

title: Dead code and unused helper functions
description: units() function is defined at line 4 but never referenced anywhere else in the module.
recommendation: Clean up dead code in M2R-v2.

title: Lack of docstrings, type annotations, and logging
description: Engine lacks type hints, structured error handling, and audit logging.
recommendation: Add comprehensive typing and logging in M2R-v2.
